title: Surreal Gallery Nightmare
description: A dimly lit room features a large ornate gold frame containing a dark painting of a blood-soaked hallway where a silhouetted figure stands over a mutilated person. To the left, a damaged green metallic pod-like machine with an open hatch and hanging wires floats in the room as rain falls from a broken skylight above.
prompt: Interior of a decaying art gallery with rain pouring through a broken skylight. A large ornate gold frame holds a painting depicting a dark blue hallway lit by red light, where a silhouetted man stands over a bloody corpse with black liquid dripping from the bottom of the frame. To the left floats a damaged retro-futuristic green metallic pod with an open hatch and exposed wires. An old chair, radio and spray can sit on a table in the foreground.
